name: @feneto/lh
description: AI harness framework for brownfield feature work with on-demand discovery, bounded context, multi-host adapters, CaveBus summaries, and verification evidence.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf dist/commands/opencode-command-bundles dist/commands/opencode-agent-bundles dist/commands/opencode-plugin-bundles && cp -r src/commands/opencode-command-bundles src/commands/opencode-agent-bundles src/commands/opencode-plugin-bundles dist/commands/ && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-readme-version.mjs && node scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:dry-run
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm publish --provenance --access public
